title.en: A jug shape travelled across the Mediterranean

alt.en: A reddish terracotta jug has a narrow neck, a pinched three-lobed mouth and one handle.
alt.zh: 红褐色陶壶有细长颈部、捏成三瓣的壶口与单侧把手。

caption.en: Phoenician terracotta trefoil jug, seventh century BCE; Met 74.51.643.
caption.zh: 腓尼基三瓣口陶壶，前七世纪；大都会74.51.643。

interpretation.en: This vessel type was imported into Cyprus and also made there. Shared shapes record exchange without implying a single territorial state.
interpretation.zh: 此类器形既输入塞浦路斯，也在当地制作。共享形制记录交流，并不意味着统一的领土国家。

title.en: A glazed tile from Ghurid-era Ghazni
title.zh: 古尔王朝时期加兹尼的釉砖

alt.en: A yellow-glazed hexagonal tile bears a running animal in relief; patches of glaze are missing.
alt.zh: 黄釉六边形砖上有一只奔跑动物的浮雕，部分釉面已经脱落。

caption.en: Hexagonal molded stonepaste tile, early thirteenth century, found at Ghazni; Met 1975.193.7.
caption.zh: 六边形模制石英陶砖，十三世纪初，发现于加兹尼；大都会1975.193.7。

interpretation.en: Excavation stratigraphy places this tile group in Ghazni’s Ghurid period. Its animal relief adds architectural decoration to the history of conquest.
interpretation.zh: 发掘地层将这组砖定于加兹尼的古尔统治时期。动物浮雕为征服史补入建筑装饰的实物。

title.en: Before the pocket classics: Aldus and Griffo in 1499
title.zh: 便携古典书之前：1499年的阿尔杜斯与格里福

alt.en: An open printed book pairs dense type with a woodcut scene.
alt.zh: 摊开的印本将密集排字与木刻场景结合。

caption.en: Hypnerotomachia Poliphili, published by Aldus in December 1499, with roman type by Griffo; Met 23.73.1.
caption.zh: 《寻爱绮梦》，阿尔杜斯于1499年12月出版，采用格里福设计的罗马体；大都会23.73.1。

interpretation.en: Griffo designed its roman type. This earlier collaboration provides a comparison with the portable italic editions that followed.
interpretation.zh: 格里福为此书设计罗马体字。较早的合作为随后出现的便携斜体版本提供了对照。

title.en: Saint James wears the pilgrim’s shell
title.zh: 圣雅各佩戴朝圣者的贝壳

alt.en: A standing stone saint wears a brimmed hat and heavy draped clothing and holds a book.
alt.zh: 站立石雕圣人戴有帽檐的帽子，披厚重衣袍，手持书本。

caption.en: Saint James the Greater, Poligny, France, about 1450–1475; limestone with traces of paint, Met 47.101.17.
caption.zh: 大圣雅各，法国波利尼，约1450—1475年；带残余彩绘的石灰石，大都会47.101.17。

interpretation.en: The shell on the hat marks the saint as a pilgrim. This is a French devotional sculpture, not a sculpture from the Santiago shrine.
interpretation.zh: 帽上的贝壳标示朝圣者身份。这是法国礼拜雕塑，并非圣地亚哥圣地的雕像。

title.en: A refugee family’s son becomes a London silversmith
title.zh: 难民家庭之子成为伦敦银匠

alt.en: Three ornate silver containers with sculptural lids stand before a closed wooden case with silver fittings.
alt.zh: 三件装饰繁复、带雕塑性盖饰的银容器，摆在装有银配件的闭合木盒前。

caption.en: Paul de Lamerie, tea caddies and sugar box, London, 1738/39; Met collection.
caption.zh: 保罗·德·拉梅里，茶叶罐与糖盒，伦敦，1738/39年；大都会藏。

interpretation.en: Made just after this entry’s focus window, the set follows the next generation of Huguenot craft in London through a luxury commission.
interpretation.zh: 这套器物稍晚于本条时间范围，通过一项奢华委托呈现伦敦胡格诺后代的工艺活动。
